layers.summary_en: Admission, batching, decode selection, speculation, and workflow-aware scheduler hooks.
layers.summary_zh: 准入、批处理、解码选择、推测执行与工作流感知调度接口。

layers.summary_en: Reuse, validity, movement, tiering, compression, security, and lifecycle decisions.
layers.summary_zh: 复用、有效性、搬移、分层、压缩、安全与生命周期机制。

layers.summary_en: MoE, adapters, quantized execution, and multimodal serving mechanisms.
layers.summary_zh: MoE、适配器、量化执行与多模态服务机制。

layers.summary_en: Replaceable attention, GEMM, MLP, and fused primitives for end-to-end serving.
layers.summary_zh: 面向端到端服务的可替换 Attention、GEMM、MLP 与融合原语。

layers.summary_en: Graph capture, compilation policy, state transitions, and safe fallback—not a compiler distribution.
layers.summary_zh: 图捕获、编译策略、状态转换与安全回退，而不是编译器发行版。

layers.summary_en: Hardware backends, workspace lifecycle, metadata, communication, and capability interfaces.
layers.summary_zh: 硬件后端、workspace 生命周期、元数据、通信与能力接口。

layers.summary_en: Request lifecycle, profiling, tracing, correctness telemetry, capacity, and cost signals.
layers.summary_zh: 请求生命周期、性能分析、追踪、正确性遥测、容量与成本信号。

layers.summary_en: Adapters for repeatable workload, failure, topology, and performance validation.
layers.summary_zh: 面向工作负载、故障、拓扑与性能的可重复评测适配器。

layers.summary_en: Deliver RIDE control-plane decisions to engine hooks and return execution status.
layers.summary_zh: 把 RIDE 控制面决策传入引擎接口，并返回执行状态。

plugins.name: DecodeSelector
plugins.summary_en: Selects among decode strategies at request or phase boundaries.
plugins.summary_zh: 在请求或阶段边界选择合适的解码策略。

plugins.name: Quality-Bounded Inference
plugins.summary_en: Maps service-level quality targets to token budgets and decode policies.
plugins.summary_zh: 把服务质量目标映射为 token 预算和解码策略。

plugins.name: Speculative Serving
plugins.summary_en: Provides versioned hooks for configuring and observing speculative serving stages.
plugins.summary_zh: 为推测服务各阶段提供版本化配置与观测接口。

plugins.name: State Scheduler
plugins.summary_en: Uses queue, memory, and execution-state signals to adjust scheduling.
plugins.summary_zh: 依据队列、内存和执行状态信号调整调度。

plugins.name: vLLM Host-Control Batching
plugins.summary_en: Optimizes request batching between host control logic and model executors.
plugins.summary_zh: 优化主机控制逻辑与模型执行器之间的请求批处理。

plugins.name: Workflow-Aware Serving
plugins.summary_en: Consumes DAG readiness and deadlines to execute a control-plane scheduling decision.
plugins.summary_zh: 接收 DAG 就绪状态和 deadline，执行控制面调度决策。

plugins.name: Ascend Speculative Decoding Acceptance
plugins.summary_en: Reports draft and target acceptance, rollback events, correctness status, and serving metrics.
plugins.summary_zh: 报告 draft/target 接受率、回滚事件、正确性状态与服务指标。

plugins.name: DiffSpec
plugins.summary_en: Existing differential speculative decoding plugin registered through vllm.general_plugins.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过 vllm.general_plugins 注册的现有差分推测解码插件。

publications.title_en: DiffSpec: Differential Speculative Decoding for Ultra-Long-Sequence Inference
publications.title_zh: DiffSpec：面向超长序列推理的差分投机解码加速系统

plugins.name: BidKV
plugins.summary_en: Framework-portable KV-pressure victim selection through native vLLM entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过原生 vLLM 入口提供可跨框架复用的 KV 压力淘汰选择。

publications.title_en: BidKV: Utility-Guided Preemption Scheduling for KV-Pressure LLM Serving
publications.title_zh: BidKV：KV 压力下大模型服务的效用引导抢占调度

plugins.name: DeltaKV
plugins.summary_en: Chooses sticky, shared-pool retrieval, live transfer, or recompute under preemptible churn.
plugins.summary_zh: 在抢占波动下选择 sticky、共享池恢复、实时迁移或重算。

plugins.name: KVPlane
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates placement and streaming behavior under measured KV pressure.
plugins.summary_zh: 在实测 KV 压力下协调放置与流式行为。

plugins.name: BidKV-MultiNPU
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates KV ownership, state consistency, and recovery across accelerator devices.
plugins.summary_zh: 跨加速设备协调 KV 归属、状态一致性与恢复。

plugins.name: PrefixWeave
plugins.summary_en: Discovers and validates exact prefix reuse through native counters and graph-safe hooks.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过原生计数器和 graph-safe 接口发现并验证精确前缀复用。

plugins.name: Suffix-KV Validity
plugins.summary_en: Validates whether suffix and stitched KV segments can be reused safely.
plugins.summary_zh: 校验 suffix 与拼接 KV 分段能否安全复用。

plugins.name: KV Materialization Scheduling
plugins.summary_en: Schedules materialization against recomputation using runtime-observed cost.
plugins.summary_zh: 依据运行时观测成本在 materialization 与重算间调度。

plugins.name: KV Materialization Arrival Control
plugins.kind_zh: 到达感知 KV 控制器
plugins.summary_en: Chooses among loading, waiting, and recomputation as request arrival conditions change.
plugins.summary_zh: 随请求到达状态变化，在加载、等待和重算之间选择。

plugins.name: NeuroMem
plugins.summary_en: Manages memory retention within configurable capacity and policy budgets.
plugins.summary_zh: 在可配置的容量与策略预算内管理记忆保留。

plugins.name: TopoDec
plugins.summary_en: Places continuation decoding according to interconnect and device topology.
plugins.summary_zh: 依据互连与设备拓扑放置续写解码任务。

plugins.name: KV Admission
plugins.summary_en: Applies admission decisions before KV allocation or reuse.
plugins.summary_zh: 在 KV 分配或复用前执行准入决策。

plugins.name: TieredKV
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates KV placement and movement across storage tiers.
plugins.summary_zh: 协调 KV 在多级存储之间的放置与迁移。

plugins.name: SegmentReuse
plugins.summary_en: Reuses validated KV segments across compatible request spans.
plugins.summary_zh: 在兼容的请求区间之间复用已验证的 KV 分段。

plugins.name: Memory Evolution
plugins.summary_en: Tracks state ownership at graph-block granularity and supports selective recomputation.
plugins.summary_zh: 按图块粒度跟踪状态归属，并支持选择性重算。

plugins.name: Adaptive Quantized KV
plugins.summary_en: Selects KV precision according to latency, memory, and accuracy trade-offs.
plugins.summary_zh: 根据时延、内存与精度权衡选择 KV 精度。

plugins.name: KV Tiering Transfer Path
plugins.summary_en: Isolates KV transfer work from serving workers and reports transfer status.
plugins.summary_zh: 将 KV 传输与服务 worker 隔离，并返回传输状态。

plugins.name: Reuse-Aware KV Compression
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates compression levels with expected reuse and validates recovered state.
plugins.summary_zh: 根据预期复用选择压缩级别，并校验恢复后的状态。

plugins.name: SecureKV
plugins.kind_zh: 安全感知 KV 插件
plugins.summary_en: Adds integrity and confidentiality controls with observable runtime overhead.
plugins.summary_zh: 为 KV 处理加入完整性与机密性控制，并记录运行开销。

plugins.name: LatchMoE
plugins.summary_en: Graph-compatible expert offloading registered through the vLLM platform plugin interface.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过 vLLM platform 插件接口注册、兼容图模式的专家卸载能力。

plugins.name: PegaFlow
plugins.summary_en: Combines sequence packing, layout, fused operators, and serving integration in one prefill plugin.
plugins.summary_zh: 在一个 prefill 插件中整合序列 packing、layout、融合算子与服务接入。

plugins.name: Ascend MoE Control
plugins.summary_en: Applies expert-placement and EPLB decisions independently of LatchMoE runtime mechanics.
plugins.summary_zh: 独立于 LatchMoE 执行机制，落实 expert placement 与 EPLB 决策。

plugins.name: Ascend Dynamic Sparse Quantization
plugins.summary_en: Coordinates dynamic sparsity and quantized execution for Ascend models.
plugins.summary_zh: 为 Ascend 模型协调动态稀疏与量化执行。

plugins.name: Ascend W4A8 Optimization
plugins.summary_en: Provides graph-compatible W4A8 execution and checkpoint compatibility checks.
plugins.summary_zh: 提供兼容图模式的 W4A8 执行与 checkpoint 兼容性检查。

plugins.name: Adapter Serving
plugins.summary_en: Schedules adapters by rank buckets and manages loading, reuse, and eviction.
plugins.summary_zh: 按 rank bucket 调度适配器，并管理加载、复用与淘汰。

plugins.name: Ascend VLM Pipeline
plugins.summary_en: Supports reproducible multimodal serving workloads, initially focused on biology applications.
plugins.summary_zh: 支持可复现的多模态服务负载，首批聚焦生物领域应用。

plugins.name: Ascend Small-M GEMM
plugins.summary_en: Provides fused GEMM primitives for small-M Ascend inference shapes.
plugins.summary_zh: 为 Ascend 推理中的 small-M 形状提供融合 GEMM 原语。

plugins.name: Ascend MLP Materialization
plugins.summary_en: Lowers MLP materialization paths into architecture-aware execution primitives.
plugins.summary_zh: 将 MLP materialization 路径 lowering 为架构感知的执行原语。

plugins.name: Attention Kernel
plugins.summary_en: Provides attention primitives through a replaceable kernel interface.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过可替换的内核接口提供 attention 原语。

plugins.name: Compilation Control
plugins.summary_en: Observes graph and compilation state, controls transitions, and provides safe fallback.
plugins.summary_zh: 观测图与编译状态、控制状态转换，并提供安全回退。

plugins.name: Platform Backend
plugins.summary_en: Exposes hardware capabilities, telemetry, control actions, and safe fallback through a common interface.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过统一接口暴露硬件能力、遥测、控制动作与安全回退。

plugins.name: Ascend Workspace Lifecycle
plugins.summary_en: Manages workspace initialization, allocation, reuse, and graph replay across the request lifecycle.
plugins.summary_zh: 在请求生命周期中管理 workspace 初始化、分配、复用与 graph replay。

plugins.name: Ascend Distributed Metadata
plugins.summary_en: Versions distributed metadata, deltas, barriers, and consistency transitions.
plugins.summary_zh: 对分布式元数据、delta、barrier 与一致性转换进行版本化。

plugins.name: Multi-NIC Communication Runtime
plugins.summary_en: Selects topology-aware communication paths across multiple NICs.
plugins.summary_zh: 在多张 NIC 之间选择拓扑感知的通信路径。

plugins.name: vLLM Ascend HUST
plugins.summary_en: Existing HUST-maintained Ascend hardware plugin with vLLM platform entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的 HUST 维护 Ascend 硬件插件，具备 vLLM platform 入口。

plugins.name: vLLM Metal HUST
plugins.summary_en: Existing Apple Silicon hardware plugin with general and platform entry points.
plugins.summary_zh: 已有的 Apple Silicon 硬件插件，具备 general 与 platform 入口。

plugins.name: Ascend Real-Workload Profiling
plugins.summary_en: Captures phase and service-path telemetry that can change an engine decision.
plugins.summary_zh: 采集能够改变引擎决策的阶段与服务路径遥测。

plugins.name: Request Lifecycle
plugins.summary_en: Exports request-phase lifecycle events and resource attribution.
plugins.summary_zh: 导出请求阶段的生命周期事件与资源归因。

plugins.name: Serving Performance Guardrails
plugins.summary_en: Captures request arrival conditions and produces comparable performance regression reports.
plugins.summary_zh: 记录请求到达条件，并生成可比较的性能回归报告。

plugins.name: Ascend Serving Roofline
plugins.summary_en: Provides calibrated phase-level signals for capacity and scheduling decisions.
plugins.summary_zh: 为容量与调度决策提供校准后的阶段级信号。

plugins.name: TraceLoom Exporter
plugins.summary_en: Exports runtime trace relationships for offline TraceLoom analysis.
plugins.summary_zh: 导出运行时追踪关系，供 TraceLoom 离线分析。

plugins.name: Serving Cost and Pricing Signals
plugins.summary_en: Exports resource usage and cost signals for service accounting and pricing models.
plugins.summary_zh: 为服务计量与定价模型导出资源使用和成本信号。

plugins.name: AnchorBench Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Connects topology and placement controls to repeatable multi-device benchmarks.
plugins.summary_zh: 把拓扑和放置控制接入可重复的多设备评测。

plugins.name: FailureFirst Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Injects repeatable failures and records normalized recovery behavior.
plugins.summary_zh: 注入可重复故障并记录规范化恢复行为。

plugins.name: Agent Workload Adapter
plugins.summary_en: Runs DAG, tool-wait, recovery, and state-reuse workloads through a common benchmark interface.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过统一评测接口运行 DAG、工具等待、恢复与状态复用负载。

plugins.name: SLO-Aware Agent Serving Connector
plugins.summary_en: Carries admission, deadline, fairness, and allocation actions into engine hooks.
plugins.summary_zh: 把准入、deadline、公平性和资源分配动作传入引擎接口。

plugins.name: Agentic KV Connector
plugins.summary_en: Converts dependency-aware reuse predictions into KV retention and eviction actions.
plugins.summary_zh: 把依赖感知的复用预测转换为 KV 保留与淘汰动作。

plugins.name: VAMOS Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies multi-model placement and capacity decisions through engine capabilities.
plugins.summary_zh: 通过引擎能力落实多模型放置与容量决策。

plugins.name: Token-Budget Governor Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies token-budget admission, delay, rejection, and fallback actions before execution.
plugins.summary_zh: 在执行前落实 token 预算准入、延迟、拒绝与回退动作。

plugins.name: Agent State Tiering Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies workflow-aware placement and prefetch actions across memory tiers.
plugins.summary_zh: 跨内存层落实工作流感知的放置与预取动作。

plugins.name: Prefix Cache Routing Reliability Connector
plugins.summary_en: Applies cache-holder routing with stale-view detection and recovery.
plugins.summary_zh: 落实缓存持有者路由，并处理陈旧视图与恢复。

plugins.name: FreshKV Connector
plugins.kind_zh: RIDE Agent 感知 KV 连接器
plugins.summary_en: Carries lifecycle and future-reuse declarations into KV retention and eviction actions.
plugins.summary_zh: 把生命周期和未来复用声明传入 KV 保留与淘汰动作。

adjacent_assets.name: Ascend Quant
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Existing model-preparation and post-training quantization toolchain; currently no vLLM runtime entry point.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 已有模型准备与训练后量化工具链；当前没有 vLLM 运行时入口。

adjacent_assets.name: Triton Ascend HUST
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Compiler and kernel infrastructure used by plugins; it is not a vLLM runtime plugin.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 为插件提供编译器和算子基础设施；它本身不是 vLLM 运行时插件。

adjacent_assets.name: Ascend Runtime Manager
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Deployment and environment-management tooling without a vLLM runtime plugin entry point.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 部署与环境管理工具，没有 vLLM 运行时插件入口。

adjacent_assets.name: TraceLoom
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Offline profiler-data analysis toolkit; runtime export is represented separately in the plugin roadmap.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 离线 profiler 数据分析工具；运行时导出能力在插件路线图中单独展示。

adjacent_assets.name: Profiling Toolkit
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Shared profiling scripts, workloads, and configuration rather than an engine runtime extension.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 共享 profiling 脚本、工作负载与配置，不是引擎运行时扩展。

adjacent_assets.name: Benchmark Suite
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Benchmark orchestration and evidence publication, kept outside the runtime plugin count.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 评测编排与证据发布，不计入运行时插件数量。

adjacent_assets.name: LMCache Ascend
adjacent_assets.summary_en: Integration project for connecting LMCache capabilities to Ascend serving.
adjacent_assets.summary_zh: 面向 Ascend 服务接入 LMCache 能力的集成项目。
